build_mdn_layer: build a PyTorch Mixture Density Network layer with configurable Gaussian components for probabilistic regression
create_mdn_forward: create a forward pass through the MDN layer to compute sigma, mu, and pi parameters from input minibatch
test_gaussian_probability: test the gaussian_probability function to compute likelihood of target values given MoG parameters
run_mdn_loss: run the mdn_loss function to calculate negative log likelihood loss for training a mixture density network
sample_mdn_distribution: sample from a Mixture of Gaussians distribution using the sample function with optional pi weights
